import requests
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Fetch papers from arXiv API for multimodal RAG
arxiv_url = "http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:multimodal+RAG&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending&max_results=5"

print("Fetching papers from arXiv API...")
response = requests.get(arxiv_url, timeout=30)
response.raise_for_status()
xml_content = response.content.decode('utf-8')

# Parse XML
root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

papers = []
for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
    paper = {
        'id': entry.find('atom:id', ns).text,
        'title': entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip(),
        'summary': entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip(),
        'published': entry.find('atom:published', ns).text,
        'updated': entry.find('atom:updated', ns).text,
        'authors': [],
        'categories': []
    }

    # Extract authors
    for author in entry.findall('atom:author', ns):
        name_el = author.find('atom:name', ns)
        if name_el is not None:
            paper['authors'].append(name_el.text.strip())

    # Extract categories
    for cat in entry.findall('atom:category', ns):
        paper['categories'].append(cat.get('term'))

    papers.append(paper)

# Generate markdown comparison table
md = "# Multimodal RAG Papers Comparison\n\n"
md += "| # | Title | Authors | Published | Categories | Summary |\n"
md += "|---|-------|---------|-----------|------------|---------|\n"

for i, p in enumerate(papers, 1):
    summary = p['summary'][:300] if len(p['summary']) > 300 else p['summary']
    md += f"| {i} | {p['title']} | {', '.join(p['authors'])} | {p['published']} | {', '.join(p['categories'])} | {summary}... |\n"

# Write to file
with open('papers.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(md)

print(f"Successfully wrote {len(papers)} papers to papers.md")
